g.text: 2022 / Optus breach
Personal information of millions of Australian customers was exposed.
2021 / Twitch source-code leak
A large data dump exposed source code, creator payout data and internal information.
2015 / Anthem breach
Personal information of nearly 79 million people was exposed in a major healthcare breach.
2023 / T-Mobile API breach
Customer data was accessed through an API-related exposure.
2017 / NotPetya
A destructive wiper spread through a compromised software update and caused billions in losses.
2011 / Sony PlayStation Network
A major intrusion exposed personal information and forced a prolonged service shutdown.
2014 / German steel mill attack
A cyber intrusion disrupted industrial control processes and caused physical equipment damage.
1988 / Morris Worm
An early internet worm spread uncontrollably and disrupted thousands of Unix systems.
2008 / Conficker
A Windows worm used multiple propagation methods and created a massive botnet.
2000 / ILOVEYOU
A malicious email attachment spread globally, overwriting files and stealing credentials.
2012 / Shamoon
A destructive wiper erased data on tens of thousands of computers at Saudi Aramco.
2018 / Exactis data exposure
A publicly accessible database exposed personal information on hundreds of millions of people.
2013 / Bangladesh Bank SWIFT heist preparation
Attackers compromised bank systems and prepared fraudulent SWIFT payment instructions.
2016 / Bangladesh Bank heist
Fraudulent SWIFT transfers stole about $81 million from the central bank's account.
2017 / WannaCry
Ransomware used EternalBlue to spread rapidly across more than 150 countries.
2018 / Marriott / Starwood breach
Guest records from the Starwood reservation environment were exposed at enormous scale.
2014 / Home Depot breach
Payment-card data was stolen after attackers gained access through compromised credentials.
2014 / Sony Pictures
Destructive malware and data theft disrupted a major entertainment company and leaked internal files.
2025 / Co-op cyberattack
A major UK retailer suffered disruption and reported customer data theft.
2020 / SolarWinds SUNBURST
A compromised software build process inserted a backdoor into trusted Orion updates.
2025 / PowerSchool data breach
A compromised support credential enabled theft of student and staff information from school districts.
2023 / Microsoft Storm-0558
A stolen signing key enabled access to email accounts at multiple organizations.
2021 / Log4Shell
A critical Log4j flaw enabled remote code execution across many exposed Java applications.
2022 / Ronin Network hack
Attackers stole cryptocurrency worth roughly $625 million from a blockchain bridge.
2018 / SingHealth breach
Health records of about 1.5 million people in Singapore were stolen.
2022 / Uber breach
Social engineering and MFA fatigue helped an intruder access internal systems.
2001 / Nimda
A multi-vector worm spread through email, web servers, network shares and vulnerable clients.
2007 / Estonia DDoS attacks
DDoS campaigns disrupted government, banking and media services.
2005 / TJX breach
Payment-card and personal data were stolen after network security weaknesses were exploited.
2020 / Blackbaud ransomware
A ransomware attack exposed data held by a widely used cloud services provider.
2007 / Zeus banking trojan
Credential-stealing malware targeted online banking and industrialized financial cybercrime.
1994 / Citibank online bank robbery
Attackers used compromised banking systems to attempt fraudulent international transfers.
2025 / Healthcare ransomware ecosystem
Attacks on healthcare providers and suppliers exposed systemic dependence on shared digital infrastructure.
2023 / Barracuda ESG zero-day
Attackers exploited an appliance vulnerability and compromised email security gateways.
2019 / Capital One breach
A cloud access-control weakness exposed data of about 100 million people.
2021 / Codecov supply-chain compromise
A modified code-coverage tool exported secrets from customer CI environments.
1999 / Melissa
A macro virus spread through Outlook address books and overwhelmed corporate email systems.
2016 / Shadow Brokers leak
Exploit tools attributed to the NSA were leaked, including EternalBlue.
2020 / Garmin ransomware
A ransomware incident disrupted services and business operations.
2021 / Microsoft Exchange ProxyLogon
Chained zero-days enabled unauthenticated server compromise and web-shell deployment.
2017 / Equifax breach
An unpatched web application vulnerability exposed sensitive information of about 147 million people.
2023 / Okta support-system breach
Attackers accessed customer support files and session-related information.
2023 / 3CX supply-chain attack
A compromised software build chain distributed malware through a trusted business application.
2013 / Yahoo breach
Attackers accessed Yahoo accounts in a breach later estimated to affect billions of accounts.
2016 / Operation Ghoul / banking malware campaigns
Credential theft and targeted malware demonstrated the growing scale of financially motivated intrusions.
2017 / Uber breach disclosure
Attackers accessed personal data and the company paid intruders to conceal the incident.
2018 / Coincheck theft
Cryptocurrency worth roughly $530 million was stolen from the exchange.
2024 / Sisense breach
A compromise exposed customer-related credentials and prompted urgent security guidance.
2015 / Ukraine power grid
Attackers remotely disrupted electricity distribution, demonstrating cyber-physical impact.
2019 / Citrix ADC exploitation
Attackers exploited gateway flaws to access enterprise networks.
2022 / Medibank breach
Criminals stole sensitive personal and health information from millions of customers.
2008 / Heartland Payment Systems
Payment-card data was stolen in a major breach involving malware.
2025 / Salt Typhoon follow-on investigations
Telecom espionage investigations highlighted the risk of persistent access to communications infrastructure.
2014 / Yahoo breach disclosure
Yahoo disclosed a massive account compromise ultimately estimated at about three billion accounts.
2024 / Ivanti Connect Secure exploitation
Zero-day vulnerabilities were used to compromise perimeter appliances and maintain access.
2009 / Operation Aurora
Targeted intrusions compromised major technology companies and sought intellectual property.
2017 / Triton / Trisis
Malware targeted industrial safety systems, raising the risk of physical harm.
2021 / Kaseya VSA
REvil abused a managed-service platform to distribute ransomware to downstream customers.
2023 / ICBC Financial Services ransomware
A ransomware incident disrupted US broker-dealer operations and Treasury-market settlement activity.
2023 / 23andMe credential stuffing
Reused passwords enabled access to user accounts and related profile data.
2015 / US OPM breach
Sensitive personnel and background-investigation records were stolen from a federal agency.
2016 / Mirai botnet
Malware hijacked poorly secured IoT devices and launched record-scale DDoS attacks.
2011 / DigiNotar CA compromise
Fraudulent certificates enabled interception of trusted encrypted connections.
2024 / Ticketmaster / Live Nation data theft
A cloud-hosted dataset was advertised for sale after unauthorized access claims.
2012 / LinkedIn breach
Password hashes for millions of accounts were stolen and later circulated.
2025 / Marks & Spencer cyber disruption
A cyberattack disrupted retail operations, online services and customer-facing processes.
2010 / Stuxnet
A sophisticated worm manipulated industrial control systems and damaged Iranian nuclear centrifuges.
2020 / Microsoft Exchange ecosystem attacks
Exchange weaknesses became a major route for enterprise compromise and persistence.
2025 / Global ransomware and identity-driven intrusions
A wave of attacks reinforced the role of stolen credentials, social engineering and third-party access.
2013 / Adobe breach
Attackers stole customer credentials and source-code-related data at large scale.
2011 / RSA SecurID breach
Attackers stole information related to RSA token technology, creating downstream authentication risk.
2019 / Baltimore city ransomware
RobbinHood ransomware disrupted municipal services and caused substantial recovery costs.
2019 / Norsk Hydro ransomware
LockerGoga disrupted global aluminium operations and forced manual processes.
2016 / DNC email compromise
Political campaign emails were stolen and publicly released.
2016 / Dyn DNS attack
Mirai-powered DDoS traffic disrupted DNS services and made major websites unreachable.
2004 / Sasser
A Windows worm exploited LSASS and spread without requiring user interaction.
2003 / Blaster
Malware exploited a Windows RPC vulnerability and triggered widespread system instability.
2001 / Code Red
A worm exploited Microsoft IIS and rapidly compromised internet-facing web servers.
2025 / Bybit cryptocurrency theft
Attackers stole approximately $1.5 billion in digital assets in one of the largest crypto heists.
2025 / Jaguar Land Rover cyberattack
A major incident halted production and disrupted supply chains and business operations.
2014 / JPMorgan Chase breach
Attackers accessed customer contact information at one of the largest US banks.
2003 / SQL Slammer
A tiny worm exploited SQL Server and caused widespread network congestion within minutes.
2017 / CCleaner supply-chain compromise
Attackers inserted a backdoor into legitimate software distributed to users.
2025 / Oracle Cloud credential exposure claims
Reports of stolen credentials and customer data triggered investigations and disputed claims.
2024 / Change Healthcare
Ransomware severely disrupted US healthcare claims, payments and prescription workflows.
2024 / CDK Global ransomware
A cyberattack disrupted dealership management systems across much of the US auto retail sector.
2024 / Salt Typhoon telecom intrusions
A state-linked espionage campaign compromised telecom providers and accessed sensitive communications data.
2021 / Accellion FTA
Zero-day exploitation enabled data theft from organizations using a legacy file-transfer appliance.
2024 / Synnovis ransomware
A ransomware attack disrupted pathology services and affected London hospitals.
2021 / Colonial Pipeline
Ransomware forced a major US fuel pipeline operator to suspend operations.
2023 / Caesars Entertainment
A social-engineering-led intrusion resulted in data theft and a reported ransom payment.
2024 / Snowflake customer-account attacks
Stolen credentials were used to access customer environments and exfiltrate data.
2022 / Costa Rica ransomware crisis
Ransomware disrupted government services and led to a national emergency declaration.
2024 / National Public Data breach
A large dataset containing personal information was exposed and circulated online.
2023 / MOVEit Transfer
Cl0p exploited a zero-day in file-transfer software to steal data from many organizations.
2022 / LastPass breach
Intruders accessed development information and later obtained encrypted customer vault backups.
2023 / MGM Resorts
Social engineering led to major operational disruption across hotel and casino systems.
2020 / Twitter account takeover
Social engineering of employees enabled attackers to hijack high-profile accounts.
2024 / AnyDesk compromise
Attackers accessed parts of the company's production systems and code-signing-related environment.
2013 / Target breach
Stolen vendor credentials enabled access to payment systems and theft of card data.
